legal_form: Charitable Incorporated Organisation (CIO), Companies House / CIO ref CE000394
site_place: St Raphael's Estate, Stonebridge, London Borough of Brent, NW10 0PW
site_activity: A network of food banks and community kitchens plus a community shop and café, acting as a gateway to welfare advice, asylum/refugee support (OpenARMS) and an award-winning community garden.
last_delivery_what: Supported 14,335 people to access nutritious food (more than 48,000 instances of crisis support) across food bank, community kitchen, welfare advice and refugee services
local_trigger: Sufra is based on St Raphael's Estate, described as the London Borough of Brent's most disadvantaged neighbourhood, and works to address rising food poverty and cost-of-living pressure locally.
lived_experience_governance: Lived experience runs through the volunteer base and advocacy: many of Sufra's volunteers were previously guests, and the 2024-25 Impact Report states the charity 'championed the voices of those with lived experience' in its campaigning. No public evidence was found of lived-experience representation specifically at trustee/board level (applicant to confirm).

programmes.name: Emergency Aid / Food Bank
programmes.what: Emergency food parcels, clothing drives and essential support; also delivers NHS food parcels to GPs and hospital departments and a Fresh Meals service.

programmes.name: Community Kitchen
programmes.what: Year-round freshly cooked meals distributed to guests, including via community kitchens and Fresh Meals.

programmes.name: Welfare Advice Service
programmes.what: Impartial welfare advice helping guests address the problems that lead them to the food bank; Advice Quality Standard (AQS) accredited.

programmes.name: OpenARMS (Asylum Seeker, Refugee & Migrant Support)
programmes.what: Support for asylum seekers, refugees and migrants, including E-Visa drop-ins; registered with the Immigration Advice Authority (IAA).

programmes.name: Community Wellbeing Project / Service
programmes.what: Hot meals, a welcoming space and activities to build resilience and wellbeing.

programmes.name: St Raphael's Edible Garden (Community Garden)
programmes.what: Award-winning community garden where volunteers and guests grow fresh produce and support wellbeing, learning and connection.

programmes.name: Volunteering & Community Engagement / Advocacy
programmes.what: Volunteering pathways (guests often become volunteers), community engagement events and campaigning for fairer policies.
